name: Extreme Close Up
text: Extreme close up, only their eyes and the bridge of the nose fill the frame.

name: Low Angle
text: Low angle hero shot, the camera close to the ground looking up at them against the sky.

name: High Angle
text: High angle shot, the camera above them looking down.

name: Top Down
text: Top down shot from directly above, looking straight down at them.

name: Drone
text: Aerial drone shot from high above, they are small in the middle of the place.

name: From Behind
text: Shot from behind them, looking past their back at what they see.

name: Over Shoulder
text: Over the shoulder shot from just behind them, their shoulder soft in the foreground.

name: Dutch Tilt
text: Dutch angle, the horizon tilted sideways, uneasy medium shot.

name: Macro
text: Macro shot of one eye, skin texture and lashes in sharp detail, very shallow focus.

name: Hands
text: Insert shot of their hands, relaxed and natural, five fingers each.

name: Cowboy
text: Cowboy shot from mid thigh up, slightly to one side.
